============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v24.22.1 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed (PeerUpdate)

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |   1169 ns | 855,686 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1653 ns | 604,858 | 350 | 1.41x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2706 ns | 369,601 | 350 | 2.32x slower |
| google-protobuf |   5863 ns | 170,553 | 350 | 5.02x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   4042 ns | 247,391 | 622 | 3.46x slower |
| JSON |   2320 ns | 430,946 | 791 | 1.99x slower |
